Name: Dragon Trinket
Author: sheepparalysis
Description: This mod changes the parrot egg into a dragon egg, which gives you a small green dragon companion. All functionality of the trinket remains unchanged, but now you have a little dragon friend to hoard gold coins for you.

Downloads.Description: Recolours the parrot egg trinket into a little dragon.
